sentences.text: CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE K.NATARAJAN  ORAL ORDER

This petition is filed by the petitioner/accused under section 482 of Cr.P.C. for quashing the criminal proceedings in Crime No.113/2021 registered by the Rajarajeshwari Nagar Police station for the offences punishable under Sections 468, 471, 420, 465 read with 34 of IPC.
2.
The respondent Nos.2 to 4 appeared through their counsel.

3. During the pendency of the petition, both petitioner and respondents appeared before the Court along with their counsels and filed joint compromise application on I.A.No.1/2024 under Section 320 read with Section 482 Cr.P.C.
4.

Learned counsel for the petitioner and respondents submits during the pendency of this crime, a civil suit is also filed in O.S.No.3614/2020 where both the parties have settled their dispute between themselves by filing compromise application and also the suit was decreed on the compromise,
where they undertook to cooperate with the petitioner for NC: 2024:KHC:51292 quashing the criminal proceedings.
Accordingly, they have filed joint compromise application.
5. The petitioner is none other than the son of the respondent No.2 and brother of the respondent Nos.3 and 4 and the dispute is between the family members.

6. In view of joint compromise between the parties and in view of the settlement of the issues,
I.A.No.1/2024 is allowed.
The parties are permitted to compound the offence.
Accordingly, the criminal petition is allowed.
Consequently, the criminal proceedings registered against the petitioner in Crime No.113/2021 registered by the Rajarajeshwari Nagar Police, is hereby quashed.

Sd/-
